quotes.text: :class:`model_selection.StratifiedGroupKFold` now raises a `ValueError` when `n_splits` is greater than the number of unique groups, preventing degenerate folds.
FIX: StratifiedGroupKFold errors when n_splits > n_groups (#33176)

summary: `StratifiedGroupKFold` splits data into folds while keeping each group in a single fold. If you ask for more splits than there are groups, some folds can't get a group at all. Its sibling `GroupKFold` already refuses this with a `ValueError` ("Cannot have number of splits … greater than the number of groups"); `StratifiedGroupKFold` didn't, and could produce degenerate folds. The fix adds the same check, and the existing test was widened to run on both classes.
teaches: Validating input and giving clear errors
title: StratifiedGroupKFold with more splits than groups

whereToLook.hint: Where it counts the groups with `np.unique`, before building the folds.
